name: Medev
description:
## About Medev

Medev is the healthcare management system built for clinics and hospitals that want full control without complexity. Whether you host it yourself or we host it for you, you get a complete solution with a customizable frontend that reflects your brand.

### Built for Modern Healthcare

Medev combines the robustness of enterprise healthcare systems with the flexibility of open-source technology. It's designed to grow with your practice — from small clinics to large hospital networks.

### Your Brand, Your Way

The included frontend website can be fully customized to match your clinic's branding and design requirements. You specify the look; we build it with the standardized Medev backend powering everything underneath.

## Ready to Transform Your Practice?

Contact us to learn how Medev can streamline your healthcare operations.

features.title: Full EHR System
features.description: Comprehensive patient records including encounters, vitals, SOAP notes, diagnoses, and electronic prescriptions.

features.title: Practice Management

features.description: SMART on FHIR v2.2.0 app integration with OAuth2-secured REST APIs for seamless third-party integrations.

features.title: Custom Branding

faq.question: What is Medev?
faq.answer: Medev is a rebranded instance of Medev v7.0.3+ — the world's leading open-source Electronic Health Records and Medical Practice Management system. It runs on a VPS via Docker.

faq.question: What features does Medev include?
faq.answer: Medev includes full EHR (patient records, encounters, vitals, SOAP notes, prescriptions), practice management (scheduling, appointments, billing), patient portal, FHIR R4 + REST API with OAuth2, and SMART on FHIR v2.2.0 app integration.

faq.question: Can I customize the patient-facing frontend?
faq.answer: Yes! Medev includes a customizable frontend website that your clinic or hospital can brand and design. You control the patient experience while the backend remains standardized with many available features and add-ons.

faq.question: Is Medev self-hosted?
faq.answer: Yes, Medev is fully self-hosted via Docker. You have full control over your data. We also offer hosting options if you prefer us to manage it for you.
